blocks.text: The CSS border properties allow you to specify the style, width, and color of an element's border.

The
border-style property specifies what kind of border to display.

items: groove - Defines a 3D grooved border. The effect depends on the border-color value
ridge - Defines a 3D ridged border. The effect depends on the border-color value
inset - Defines a 3D inset border. The effect depends on the border-color value
outset - Defines a 3D outset border. The effect depends on the border-color value

blocks.text:
The
border-style property can have from one to four values (for
the top border, right border, bottom border, and the left border).

blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text:
None of the OTHER CSS border properties (which you will learn more about in the next chapters) will have ANY effect unless the

  border-style property is set!
